title: 1977 Mozambican general election
summary: Mozambique held its first elections after independence in 1977, with FRELIMO as the only legal party. The movement had fought the Portuguese state from 1964, been recognised at Lusaka in September 1974 as the party Portugal would hand over to, and taken the state at independence on 25 June 1975; its third congress, in February 1977, had just declared it a Marxist-Leninist vanguard party. The ballot returned a People's Assembly from lists the party controlled. It is in the atlas as the form independence took in the largest of the African territories, and as the far end of the chain that begins with the attack at Chai in 1964.
